children.title: 📚 Learn
Designing Machine Learning Systems — Scalable, maintainable ML pipelines (Chip Huyen).
AI Engineering — End-to-end AI product building (Chip Huyen).
Build a Large Language Model from Scratch — Transformers in raw PyTorch, layer by layer (Sebastian Raschka).
Hands-On Large Language Models — Visual + practical guide to LLM applications (Jay Alammar, Maarten Grootendorst).
LLM Engineer's Handbook — Production LLMOps: fine-tuning, quantization, serving (Labonne, Iusztin).
The 100-Page Language Models Book — Concise, math-grounded path from n-grams to transformers (Andriy Burkov).
Generative Deep Learning (2nd Edition) — GANs, VAEs, diffusion models (David Foster).
Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach — The canonical AI theory text (Russell, Norvig).
Deep Learning — Mathematical foundations of neural networks (Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville).
Deep Learning: Foundations and Concepts — Bishop's 2024 update; probability-grounded modern DL (Bishop & Bishop).
Understanding Deep Learning — Math + intuition + Python notebooks (Simon Prince).
Speech and Language Processing (3rd Edition) — The NLP reference, kept current through the deep learning era (Jurafsky, Martin).
Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd Edition) — RL foundations (Sutton, Barto).
Google Generative AI Learning Path
Hugging Face LLM Course
Fast.ai — Practical Deep Learning
Stanford CS324: Large Language Models
Full Stack Deep Learning
MIT 6.S191: Intro to Deep Learning
DeepLearning.AI Short Courses
Google DeepMind — Introduction to Reinforcement Learning
Karpathy — Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
Attention Is All You Need — Transformer architecture.
Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models — Model/data/compute scaling.
Language Models are Few-Shot Learners — GPT-3 capabilities.
Constitutional AI — Safer model alignment.
🛠 Build
Building Effective Agents (Anthropic) — ⭐ Patterns, pitfalls, and tradeoffs for designing AI agents.
OpenAI Agents Guide — Practical guide on building agents.
Google AI Agents Paper — Practical guide to building AI agents from Google.
Google Agents Companion Paper — Companion guide from Google.
OpenAI Cookbook — Example code, recipes, and best practices for working with OpenAI APIs.
LLM Engineer Handbook — A goldmine of useful links for AI engineers.
PocketFlow — Extremely minimalist AI agent framework in just 100 lines of code. Fantastic way to learn.
Google ADK — Google's Agent Development Kit (Python, Java). Great local development experience + A2A + MCP.
Pydantic-AI — Typed, structured LLM orchestration framework built on Pydantic models for safe, predictable outputs.
LangGraph — Build multi-agent workflows with stateful graphs on top of LangChain.
CrewAI — Agent orchestration with structured tasks and human-in-the-loop controls.
AutoGen — Microsoft's framework for multi-agent conversation and collaboration.
LlamaIndex — Data framework for ingesting, indexing, and querying private data with LLMs.
Haystack — Open-source search/RAG framework with modular pipelines.
Docling — Great library for ingesting any kind of document for RAG ⭐
OpenAI Evals — OpenAI's framework for writing evals.
Cursor — LLM-powered IDE for multi-file edits and codebase-aware chat.
GitHub Copilot — In-IDE code completion, chat, and refactors.
🤖 Agents
Claude Code — Anthropic's CLI agent; multi-file codebase refactoring with long context.
Codex CLI — OpenAI's Rust-based local terminal agent; lightweight and fast.
Gemini CLI — Google's official open-source terminal agent; long-context repo exploration.
Cursor CLI — Cursor's terminal-native agent with sandboxed permissions.
Aider — Git-integrated pair programming with surgical edits and undo.
OpenCode — Provider-agnostic terminal harness with a strong TUI.
OpenHands — Open-source autonomous SWE platform; browser + shell + editor loop.
Cline — Open-source agentic IDE extension with strong multi-provider support.
Continue — Open-source IDE + CLI assistant with source-controlled rules.
Goose — Block's extensible, MCP-driven local agent.
Factory Droid — Benchmark-leading multi-model harness with BYOK local execution.
Amp — Sourcegraph's commercial agentic coding tool with strong product UX.
Mistral Vibe — Mistral's agentic coding CLI, powered by Devstral.
Qwen Code — Alibaba's terminal coding agent, optimized for Qwen models.
Pi — Highly customizable terminal harness; minimal base prompt, extension-driven.
Nanocoder — Private, local-first agent for Ollama and LM Studio.
Kilo CLI — Multi-mode agent with a unified gateway to 500+ models.
🧠 Models
ChatGPT — Best for general reasoning, tool use, and the broadest ecosystem.
Claude — Best for long-context analysis, coding, and structured thinking.
Gemini — Best for multimodal tasks and Google ecosystem integration.
Grok — Best for real-time information via X and very long context.
Llama — Best open-weight family for self-hosting and fine-tuning.
Mistral — Best for lightweight, high-performance open-weight models.
DeepSeek — Best for cost-efficient reasoning with open weights.
Qwen — Best for multilingual and Chinese-first applications.
Kimi — Best for long-context instruction following.
GLM — Frontier-tier Chinese model with open weights.
Cohere — Best for enterprise LLMs with strong retrieval-augmented generation APIs.
GPT Image — OpenAI's integrated image generation with near-perfect text rendering.
Midjourney — Artistic and photorealistic images.
Adobe Firefly — Integrated into Creative Cloud; commercial-safe.
Ideogram — Precise, legible text in generated images.
Flux — High-res, prompt-editable, open-weight images.
Google Veo — High-quality video with synchronized audio.
Runway — Video editing + generation with granular creative control.
Kling — Cinematic, realistic video generation.
ElevenLabs — High-quality text-to-speech and voice cloning.
Suno — AI music from text prompts.
OpenRouter — Unified API + live pricing across 300 models.
LMArena — Human-preference Elo rankings for text, image, and video.
Artificial Analysis — Speed, price, and quality benchmarks across providers.

children.title: P2NIA: Privacy-Preserving Non-Iterative Auditing
children.description: (ECAI) Proposes a mutually beneficial collaboration for both the auditor and the platform: a privacy-preserving and non-iterative audit scheme that enhances fairness assessments using synthetic or local data, avoiding the challenges associated with traditional API-based audits.

children.description: (ICML) Formally establishes the conditions under which an auditor can prevent audit manipulations using prior knowledge about the ground truth.

children.description: (AAAI) Auditing as a black-box optimization problem where the goal is to automatically uncover input-output pairs of the target LLMs that exhibit illegal, immoral, or unsafe behaviors.

children.title: Queries, Representation & Detection: The Next 100 Model Fingerprinting Schemes
children.description: (AAAI) Divides model fingerprinting into three core components, to identify ∼100 previously unexplored combinations of these and gain insights into their performance.

children.title: Hardware and software platform inference
children.description: (arXiv) A method for identifying the underlying GPU architecture and software stack of a black-box machine learning model solely based on its input-output behavior.

children.title: Auditing Local Explanations is Hard
children.description: (NeurIPS) Gives the (prohibitive) query complexity of auditing explanations.

children.title: LLMs hallucinate graphs too: a structural perspective
children.description: (complex networks) Queries LLMs for known graphs and studies topological hallucinations. Proposes a structural hallucination rank.

children.title: Fairness Auditing with Multi-Agent Collaboration
children.description: (ECAI) Considers multiple

children.title: [Mapping the Field of Algorithm Auditing: A Systematic Literature Review
FairProof: Confidential and Certifiable Fairness for Neural Networks
children.description: (Arxiv) Proposes an alternative paradigm to traditional auditing using crytographic tools like Zero-Knowledge Proofs; gives a system called FairProof for verifying fairness of small neural networks.

children.title: Under manipulations, are some AI models harder to audit?
children.description: (SATML) Relates the difficulty of black-box audits

children.title: Improved Membership Inference Attacks Against Language Classification Models
children.description: (ICLR) Presents a framework for running membership inference attacks against classifier, in audit mode.

children.title: Auditing Fairness by Betting
children.description: (Neurips) [[Code]](https://github.com/bchugg/auditing-fairness) Sequential methods that allows for the continuous monitoring of incoming data from a black-box classifier or regressor.

children.title: Privacy Auditing with One (1) Training Run
children.description: (NeurIPS - best paper) A scheme for auditing differentially private machine learning systems with a single training run.

children.title: Auditing fairness under unawareness through counterfactual reasoning
children.description: (Information Processing & Management) Shows how to unveil whether a black-box model, complying with the regulations, is still biased or not.

children.title: XAudit : A Theoretical Look at Auditing with Explanations
children.description: (Arxiv) Formalizes the role of explanations in auditing and investigates if and how model explanations

children.title: Keeping Up with the Language Models: Robustness-Bias Interplay in NLI Data and Models
children.description: (Arxiv) Proposes a way to extend the shelf-life of auditing datasets by using language models themselves; also finds problems with the current bias auditing metrics and proposes alternatives -- these alternatives highlight that model brittleness superficially increased the previous bias scores.

children.title: Online Fairness Auditing through Iterative Refinement
children.description: (KDD) Provides an adaptive process that automates the inference of probabilistic guarantees associated with estimating fairness metrics.

children.title: Stealing the Decoding Algorithms of Language Models
children.description: (CCS) Steal the type and hyperparameters of the decoding algorithms of a LLM.

children.title: Modeling rabbit‑holes on YouTube
children.description: (SNAM) Models the trapping dynamics of users in rabbit holes in YouTube, and provides a measure of this enclosure.

children.title: Auditing YouTube’s Recommendation Algorithm for Misinformation Filter Bubbles
children.description: (Transactions on Recommender Systems) What it takes to “burst the bubble,” i.e., revert the bubble enclosure from recommendations.

children.title: Auditing Yelp’s Business Ranking and Review Recommendation Through the Lens of Fairness
children.description: (Arxiv) Audits the fairness of Yelp’s business

children.title: Confidential-PROFITT: Confidential PROof of FaIr Training of Trees
children.description: (ICLR) Proposes fair decision tree learning algorithms along with zero-knowledge proof protocols to obtain a proof of fairness on the audited server.

children.title: SCALE-UP: An Efficient Black-box Input-level Backdoor Detection via Analyzing Scaled Prediction Consistency
children.description: (ICLR) Considers backdoor detection under the black-box setting in machine learning as a service (MLaaS) applications.

children.title: Two-Face: Adversarial Audit of Commercial Face Recognition Systems
children.description: (ICWSM) Performs an adversarial audit on multiple systems APIs and datasets, making a number of concerning observations.

children.title: Scaling up search engine audits: Practical insights for algorithm auditing
children.description: (Journal of Information Science) (Code) Audits multiple search engines using simulated browsing behavior with virtual agents.

children.title: A zest of lime: towards architecture-independent model distances
children.description: (ICLR) Measures the distance between two remote models using LIME.

children.title: Active Fairness Auditing
children.description: (ICML) Studies of query-based auditing algorithms that can estimate the demographic parity of ML models in a query-efficient manner.

children.title: Look at the Variance! Efficient Black-box Explanations with Sobol-based Sensitivity Analysis
children.description: (NeurIPS) Sobol indices provide an efficient way to capture higher-order interactions between image regions and their contributions to a (black box) neural network’s prediction through the lens of variance.

children.title: Your Echos are Heard: Tracking, Profiling, and Ad Targeting in the Amazon Smart Speaker Ecosystem
children.description: (arxiv) Infers a link between the Amazon Echo system and the ad targeting algorithm.

children.title: When the Umpire is also a Player: Bias in Private Label Product Recommendations on E-commerce Marketplaces
children.description: (FAccT) Do Amazon private label products get an unfair share of recommendations and are therefore advantaged compared to 3rd party products?

children.title: Everyday Algorithm Auditing: Understanding the Power of Everyday Users in Surfacing Harmful Algorithmic Behaviors
children.description: (CHI) Makes the case for "everyday algorithmic auditing" by users.

children.title: Auditing Black-Box Prediction Models for Data Minimization Compliance
children.description: (NeurIPS) Measures the level of data minimization satisfied by the prediction model using a limited number of queries.

children.title: Setting the Record Straighter on Shadow Banning
children.description: (INFOCOM) (Code) Considers the possibility of shadow banning in Twitter (ie, the moderation black-box algorithm), and measures the probability of several hypothesis.

children.title: Extracting Training Data from Large Language Models
children.description: (USENIX Security) Extract verbatim text sequences from the GPT-2 model’s training data.

children.title: FairLens: Auditing black-box clinical decision support systems
children.description: (Information Processing & Management) Presents a pipeline to detect and explain potential fairness issues in Clinical DSS, by comparing different multi-label classification disparity measures.

children.title: Auditing Algorithmic Bias on Twitter
children.description: (WebSci).

children.title: Bayesian Algorithm Execution: Estimating Computable Properties of Black-box Functions Using Mutual Information
children.description: (ICML) A budget constrained and Bayesian optimization procedure to extract properties out of a black-box algorithm.

children.title: Black-Box Ripper: Copying black-box models using generative evolutionary algorithms
children.description: (NeurIPS) Replicates the functionality of a black-box neural model, yet with no limit on the amount of queries (via a teacher/student scheme and an evolutionary search).

children.title: Auditing radicalization pathways on
children.description: (FAT) Studies the reachability of radical channels from each others, using random walks on static channel recommendations.

children.title: Adversarial Model Extraction on Graph Neural Networks
children.description: (AAAI Workshop on Deep Learning on Graphs: Methodologies and Applications) Introduces GNN model extraction and presents a preliminary approach for this.

children.title: Remote Explainability faces the bouncer problem
children.description: (Nature Machine Intelligence volume 2, pages529–539) (Code) Shows the impossibility (with one request) or the difficulty to spot lies on the explanations of a remote AI decision.

children.title: GeoDA: a geometric framework for black-box adversarial attacks
children.description: (CVPR) (Code) Crafts adversarial examples to fool models, in a pure blackbox setup (no gradients, inferred class only).

children.title: The Imitation Game: Algorithm Selectionby Exploiting Black-Box Recommender
children.description: (Netys) (Code) Parametrize a local recommendation algorithm by imitating the decision of a remote and better trained one.

children.title: Auditing News Curation Systems:A Case Study Examining Algorithmic and Editorial Logic in Apple News
children.description: (ICWSM) Audit study of Apple News as a sociotechnical news curation system (trending stories section).

children.title: Auditing Algorithms: On Lessons Learned and the Risks of DataMinimization
children.description: (AIES) A practical audit for a well-being recommendation app developed by Telefónica (mostly on bias).

children.title: Extracting Training Data from Large Language Models
children.description: (arxiv) Performs a training data extraction attack to recover individual training examples by querying the language model.

children.title: Adversarial Frontier Stitching for Remote Neural Network Watermarking
children.description: (Neural Computing and Applications) (Alternative implementation) Check if a remote machine learning model is a "leaked" one: through standard API requests to a remote model, extract (or not) a zero-bit watermark, that was inserted to watermark valuable models (eg, large deep neural networks).

children.title: Knockoff Nets: Stealing Functionality of Black-Box Models
children.description: (CVPR) Ask to what extent can an adversary steal functionality of such "victim" models based solely on blackbox interactions: image in, predictions out.

children.title: Opening Up the Black Box:Auditing Google's Top Stories Algorithm
children.description: (Flairs-32) Audit of the Google's Top stories panel that pro-vides insights into its algorithmic choices for selectingand ranking news publisher

children.title: Making targeted black-box evasion attacks effective andefficient
children.description: (arXiv) Investigates how an adversary can optimally use its query budget for targeted evasion attacks against deep neural networks.

children.title: Online Learning for Measuring Incentive Compatibility in Ad Auctions
children.description: (WWW) Measures the incentive compatible- (IC) mechanisms (regret) of black-box auction platforms.

children.title: TamperNN: Efficient Tampering Detection of Deployed Neural Nets
children.description: (ISSRE) Algorithms to craft inputs that can detect the tampering with a remotely executed classifier model.

children.title: Neural Network Model Extraction Attacks in Edge Devicesby Hearing Architectural Hints
children.description: (arxiv) Through the acquisition of memory access events from bus snooping, layer sequence identification bythe LSTM-CTC model, layer topology connection according to the memory access pattern, and layer dimension estimation under data volume constraints, it demonstrates one can accurately recover the a similar network architecture as the attack starting point

children.title: Stealing Knowledge from Protected Deep Neural Networks Using Composite Unlabeled Data
children.description: (ICNN) Composite method which can be used to attack and extract the knowledge ofa black box model even if it completely conceals its softmaxoutput.

children.title: Neural Network Inversion in Adversarial Setting via Background Knowledge Alignment
children.description: (CCS) Model inversion approach in the adversary setting based on training an inversion model that acts as aninverse of the original model. With no fullknowledge about the original training data, an accurate inversion is still possible by training the inversion model on auxiliary samplesdrawn from a more generic data distribution.

children.title: Counterfactual Explanations without Opening the Black Box: Automated Decisions and the GDPR
children.description: (Harvard Journal of Law & Technology) To explain a decision on x, find a conterfactual: the closest point to x that changes the decision.

children.title: Distill-and-Compare: Auditing Black-Box Models Using Transparent Model Distillation
children.description: (AIES) Treats black box models as teachers, training transparent student models to mimic the risk scores assigned by black-box models.

children.title: Towards Reverse-Engineering Black-Box Neural Networks
children.description: (ICLR) (Code) Infer inner hyperparameters (eg number of layers, non-linear activation type) of a remote neural network model by analysing its response patterns to certain inputs.

children.title: Data driven exploratory attacks on black box classifiers in adversarial domains
children.description: (Neurocomputing) Reverse engineers remote classifier models (e.g., for evading a CAPTCHA test).

children.title: xGEMs: Generating Examplars to Explain Black-Box Models
children.description: (arXiv) Searches bias in the black box model by training an unsupervised implicit generative model. Thensummarizes the black-box model behavior quantitatively by perturbing data samples along the data manifold.

children.title: Learning Networks from Random Walk-Based Node Similarities
children.description: (NIPS) Reversing graphs by observing some random walk commute times.

children.title: Identifying the Machine Learning Family from Black-Box Models
children.description: (CAEPIA) Determines which kind of machine learning model is behind the returned predictions.

children.title: Stealing Neural Networks via Timing Side Channels
children.description: (arXiv) Stealing/approximating a model through timing attacks usin queries.

children.title: Copycat CNN: Stealing Knowledge by Persuading Confession with Random Non-Labeled Data
children.description: (IJCNN) (Code) Stealing black-box models (CNNs) knowledge by querying them with random natural images (ImageNet and Microsoft-COCO).

children.title: Auditing the Personalization and Composition of Politically-Related Search Engine Results Pages
children.description: (WWW) A Chrome extension to survey participants and collect the Search Engine Results Pages (SERPs) and autocomplete suggestions, for studying personalization and composition.

children.title: Uncovering Influence Cookbooks : Reverse Engineering the Topological Impact in Peer Ranking Services
children.description: (CSCW) Aims at identifying which centrality metrics are in use in a peer ranking service.

children.title: The topological face of recommendation: models and application to bias detection
children.description: (Complex Networks) Proposes a bias detection framework for items recommended to users.

children.title: Membership Inference Attacks Against Machine Learning Models
children.description: (Symposium on Security and Privacy) Given a machine learning model and a record, determine whether this record was used as part of the model's training dataset or not.

children.title: Practical Black-Box Attacks against Machine Learning
children.description: (Asia CCS) Understand how vulnerable is a remote service to adversarial classification attacks.

children.title: Algorithmic Transparency via Quantitative Input Influence: Theory and Experiments with Learning Systems
children.description: (IEEE S&P) Evaluate the individual, joint and marginal influence of features on a model using shapley values.

children.title: Auditing Black-Box Models for Indirect Influence
children.description: (ICDM) Evaluate the influence of a variable on a black-box model by "cleverly" removing it from the dataset and looking at the accuracy gap

children.title: Iterative Orthogonal Feature Projection for Diagnosing Bias in Black-Box Models
children.description: (FATML Workshop) Performs feature ranking to analyse black-box models

children.title: Bias in Online Freelance Marketplaces: Evidence from TaskRabbit
children.description: (dat workshop) Measures the TaskRabbit's search algorithm rank.

children.title: Stealing Machine Learning Models via Prediction APIs
children.description: (Usenix Security) (Code) Aims at extracting machine learning models in use by remote services.

children.title: “Why Should I Trust You?”Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
children.description: (arXiv) (Code) Explains a blackbox classifier model by sampling around data instances.

children.title: Back in Black: Towards Formal, Black Box Analysis of Sanitizers and Filters
children.description: (Security and Privacy) Black-box analysis of sanitizers and filters.

children.title: Algorithmic Transparency via Quantitative Input Influence: Theory and Experiments with Learning Systems
children.description: (Security and Privacy) Introduces measures that capture the degree of influence of inputs on outputs of the observed system.

children.title: An Empirical Analysis of Algorithmic Pricing on Amazon Marketplace
children.description: (WWW) (Code) Develops a methodology for detecting algorithmic pricing, and use it empirically to analyze their prevalence and behavior on Amazon Marketplace.

children.title: Certifying and Removing Disparate Impact
children.description: (SIGKDD) Proposes SVM-based methods to certify absence of bias and methods to remove biases from a dataset.

children.title: Peeking Beneath the Hood of Uber
children.description: (IMC) Infer implementation details of Uber's surge price algorithm.

children.title: [A peek into the black box: exploring classifiers by randomization]()
children.description: (Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery journal) (code) Finds groups of features that can be permuted without changing the output label of predicted samples

children.title: XRay: Enhancing the Web's Transparency with Differential Correlation
children.description: (USENIX Security) Audits which user profile data were used for targeting a particular ad, recommendation, or price.

children.title: Measuring Personalization of Web Search
children.description: (WWW) Develops a methodology for measuring personalization in Web search result.

children.title: Auditing: Active Learning with Outcome-Dependent Query Costs
children.description: (NIPS) Learns from a binary classifier paying only for negative labels.

children.title: Query Strategies for Evading Convex-Inducing Classifiers
children.description: (JMLR) Evasion methods for convex classifiers. Considers evasion complexity.

children.title: Privacy Oracle: a System for Finding Application Leakswith Black Box Differential Testing
children.description: (CCS) Privacy Oracle: a system that uncovers applications' leaks of personal information in transmissions to remoteservers.

children.title: Adversarial Learning
children.description: (KDD) Reverse engineering of remote linear classifiers, using membership queries.

children.title: Books
Wiener, N. (2016). Cybernetics or control and communication in the animal and the machine.
children.description: The book introduced the term cybernetics to describe a self-regulation mechanism.

children.title: Scheffer, M. (2009). Critical transitions in nature and society. Princeton, N.J: Princeton University Press.
children.description: A nicely written and accessible description of the critical transition and related concepts.

children.title: Nicolis, G., Basios, V., & (Firm), W. S. (2015). Chaos, information processing and paradoxical games: the legacy of John S. Nicolis. Singapore; Hackensack, N.J.: World Scientific Pub. Co.
children.description: An edited volume of studies honoring the legacy of John Nicolis contribution to complex systems.

children.title: Newman, M. E. J. (2010). Networks: an introduction. Oxford; New York: Oxford University Press.
children.description: A comprehensive introduction to network science.

children.title: Mitchell, S. D. (2013). Unsimple truths: science, complexity, and policy. Chicago: Univ. of Chicago Press.
children.description: The book introduces the perspective of integrative puralism as a way of understanding and studying the world.

children.title: Maturana, H. R., & Varela, F. J. (2008). The tree of knowledge: the biological roots of human understanding. Boston: Shambhala.
children.description: The book is an exposition of the non-representational vew of knowledge.

children.title: Mandelbrot, B. (2006). The fractal geometry of nature. New York: W.H. Freeman and Company.
children.description: Beautiful introduction to the world of fractals.

children.title: Kauffman, S. (2014). At Home in the Universe The Search for the Laws of Self-Organization and Complexity. Cary: Oxford University Press, USA.
children.description: The book introduces in an accessible way the influence of concepts such as self-organization and the edge of chaos.

children.title: Gros, C. (2015). Complex and adaptive dynamical systems: a primer. Cham: Springer.
children.description: Technical and accessible introduction to a number of important concepts in complex systems science.

children.title: Downey, A. (2012). Think complexity. Needham, Massachusetts: Green Tea Press.
children.description: A hands-on approach exploring complex systems models with Python.

children.title: Boccara, N. (2014). Modeling complex systems. Springer-Verlag New York.
children.description: An overview of important mathematical models of complex systems.

children.title: Barrat, A., Barthelemy, M., & Vespignani, A. (2013). Dynamical processes on complex networks. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press
children.description: Dynamic models on complex networks.
